answer: Resist sybils with slashable sponsorship. Every newcomer must be countersigned by an established sponsor whose vouching capacity is capped by earned reputation; if the ward cheats, the sponsor burns alongside it, so vouching is underwriting, not liking. Each identity is a vertex admitted through a liable edge, never self-declared. A sponsor cannot lantern a whole farm: capacity limits and kin-detection cap clones at zero weight. The kernel of the cost: an attacker must first earn real reputation to spend it on wards that explode on contact - honest sponsors vouch only for what they verified.
